boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Drake University
boards.description: Navigate the late-night landscape near Drake University, from 24-hour convenience hubs to student-driven alcohol-alternative events and off-campus diners.

cards.title: Spike's C-Store
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Visit this on-campus convenience store for frozen meals and snacks. It remains open until midnight daily, serving as a primary late-night food source for residential students.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus late-night convenience store located in the Olmsted Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Spike's C-Store is open until midnight every day, providing food options after the dining hall closes.
cards.source_title: Hubbell Dining Hall shortens hours, now closes at 8:30 daily - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:00 AM daily during the academic semester.

cards.title: Drake Diner
cards.subtitle: Cottage Grove Avenue
cards.notes: Order classic comfort food at this retro-style diner located just south of campus. It is a neighborhood landmark known for serving breakfast all day in an upscale atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A landmark retro diner south of campus serving classic American comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Diner is a Des Moines landmark located just south of the Drake University campus.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday; 9:00 PM other nights.

cards.title: QuikTrip on University
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by this 24-hour hub for grab-and-go pizza, taquitos, and fountain drinks. It serves as a reliable off-campus destination for students needing fuel or snacks at any hour.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and gas station frequently used by students for late-night snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: QuikTrip locations, including the one at 614 University Ave, are open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Dogtown After Hours
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Participate in this annual alcohol-alternative event featuring free food, games, and student performances. It is designed to provide a safe, late-night social environment.
cards.short_summary: An annual student-driven alcohol-alternative event held late into the night.
cards.evidence_claim: Dogtown After Hours is an alcohol-alternative program that takes over the Olmsted Center with free activities and food.
cards.source_title: Dogtown After Hours (DTAH) - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Annual spring event; typically runs late into the evening.

cards.title: Dough Co. Pizza
cards.subtitle: Dogtown District
cards.notes: Grab a New York-style slice at this local pizza shop in the Drake neighborhood. It is a popular spot for students looking for a late meal near the campus perimeter.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop in the Drake neighborhood serving New York-style thin crust.
cards.evidence_claim: Dough Co. Pizza serves New York style thin crust pizza in the Drake neighborhood of Des Moines.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.

cards.title: Abelardo's Mexican Fresh
cards.subtitle: East Euclid Avenue
cards.notes: Drive through for authentic tacos and burritos at this regional favorite. Known for its late-night availability, it is a go-to for students with late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A popular Mexican fast-food spot known for being open late for drive-thru orders.
cards.evidence_claim: Abelardo's Mexican Fresh is advertised as being open late for late-night cravings.
cards.source_title: Open late for those late-night cravings - Abelardo's Mexican Fresh
cards.access_notes: Many locations open until 12:00 AM or later.

cards.title: Perkins on Euclid
cards.subtitle: East Euclid Avenue
cards.notes: Meet for late-night pancakes or pie at this 24-hour weekend destination. It provides a classic sit-down environment for study breaks or post-event meals.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour weekend restaurant and bakery serving breakfast and comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins on E Euclid Ave is open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Perkins at 2425 E Euclid Ave. Des Moines, IA
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday; until 12:00 AM other days.

cards.title: Casey's Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Northwest 6th Drive
cards.notes: Order a signature breakfast pizza or a late-night pie from this Iowa staple. The 24/7 pumps and late kitchen hours make it a frequent stop for student commuters.
cards.short_summary: A regional convenience store chain famous for its pizza, with 24/7 fuel access.
cards.evidence_claim: Casey's offers pizza delivery and pickup with 24/7 pump access at various Des Moines locations.
cards.source_title: 6565 Nw 6th Dr - Pizza Delivery and Pickup | Casey's
cards.access_notes: Pumps open 24/7; kitchen typically open until 10:00 PM or 11:00 PM.

cards.title: Cowles Library
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the study spaces in the main campus library during finals week when hours are often extended. It is the central hub for late-night academic preparation.
cards.short_summary: The main university library providing late-night study spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library provides study spaces and typically operates until 1:00 AM or later during peak academic periods.
cards.source_title: Opening Hours - Cowles Library - Drake University
cards.access_notes: Standard hours until 1:00 AM; 24-hour access often provided during finals.

cards.title: Starbucks at Olmsted
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Grab a late-evening caffeine fix at this on-campus Starbucks. It serves as a social and study anchor in the student union until its nightly closing.
cards.short_summary: The on-campus Starbucks location providing coffee and snacks until mid-evening.
cards.evidence_claim: The campus Starbucks at Olmsted closes at 9:00 PM Monday through Thursday.
cards.source_title: Hubbell Dining Hall shortens hours - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 PM Monday-Thursday; earlier on weekends.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the functional study hubs, quiet lounges, and collaborative spaces where Drake students actually spend their time between classes.

cards.title: Upper Floor Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Johansen Student Center
cards.notes: Head to the upper floors for individual study pods that offer more privacy than the exposed ground-floor seating areas.
cards.short_summary: Private study pods located on the upper levels of the newly renovated Johansen Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Johansen Student Center features small study pods above the ground floor for students who need to avoid distractions.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 8:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. for student use.

cards.title: Lower Level Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center
cards.notes: Find these rooms adjacent to Underground Fitness; they are often unlocked and available for student use when not reserved for meetings.
cards.short_summary: Quiet meeting rooms with whiteboards located on the lower level of the Olmsted Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Two meeting rooms underneath the Olmsted Center are unlocked for student use as long as the building is open and no meetings are scheduled.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Accessible during Olmsted Center operating hours; check for scheduled meetings on the door.

cards.title: Second Floor Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Meredith Hall Room 204
cards.notes: Utilize this dedicated lounge space in the heart of the journalism building for quick study sessions between classes.
cards.short_summary: A student lounge located on the second floor of the Mies van der Rohe-designed Meredith Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Meredith Hall Room 204 is designated as a Student's Lounge on the official building floor plan.
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours, typically Monday-Friday.

cards.title: Second Floor Science Hub
cards.subtitle: Science Connector Building
cards.notes: Join the interdisciplinary mix of pharmacy and biology students in this modern, glass-walled collaborative space.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative 'hub' space on the second floor designed for interdisciplinary student work.
cards.evidence_claim: The second floor of the Science Connector Building features a central hub designed for teamwork and interdisciplinary collaboration.
cards.source_title: Students thrive in beautiful new academic buildings - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours.

cards.title: The Think Tank
cards.subtitle: Collier-Scripps Hall Lower Level
cards.notes: Look for this specialized conference room on the lower level for group brainstorming and collaborative projects.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level conference and collaboration room known as the 'think tank'.
cards.evidence_claim: Collier-Scripps Hall includes a lower-level conference room specifically called the 'think tank' for student and faculty use.
cards.source_title: Collier-Scripps Hall Opens its Doors - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Available for student use; some rooms may require reservation via the EMS system.

cards.title: Lower Level Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Aliber Hall
cards.notes: Escape the busier campus spots by heading to the lower level of the business building for this dedicated reading area.
cards.short_summary: A quiet student reading room located on the lower level of Aliber Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The lower level of Aliber Hall contains a computer laboratory and a dedicated student reading room.
cards.access_notes: Open during Aliber Hall's standard operating hours.

cards.title: The Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Cowles Library
cards.notes: Visit this classic library space for traditional quiet study; check the calendar for occasional student events held here.
cards.short_summary: A large, traditional quiet study space within the university's main library.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library features a Reading Room used for both quiet study and various student orientation events.
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; typically 8:00 a.m. to midnight during the semester.

cards.title: Top Floor Graphics Labs
cards.subtitle: Carnegie Hall
cards.notes: Graphic design students have 24-hour access to these advanced labs and a large gathering space for critiques.
cards.short_summary: Specialized computer graphics labs and gathering spaces for design students.
cards.evidence_claim: The top floor of Carnegie Hall houses the Graphic Design program with 24-hour access to two large computer labs for its students.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access available specifically for students in the Graphic Design program.

cards.title: FAC Practice Rooms
cards.subtitle: Harmon Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Dozens of small practice rooms are available here, providing a place for music students to hunker down and focus.
cards.short_summary: Individual practice rooms located within the Harmon Fine Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Harmon Fine Arts Center contains dozens of practice rooms and studios for student use.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Primary access for music, theatre, and art students; hours vary by department.

cards.title: The Beach Room
cards.subtitle: Goodwin-Kirk Residence Hall
cards.notes: Residents can sign out the key for this themed study room to get a change of scenery without leaving the building.
cards.short_summary: A themed study room available for residents of Goodwin-Kirk Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Goodwin-Kirk Hall features an open study room known as the 'Beach Room' for student use.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Available to residents; keys can be signed out at the front desk.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore free social spaces and activities at Drake University, from contemporary art galleries and fitness classes to quiet study lounges and outdoor campus landmarks.

cards.title: Browse Contemporary Art
cards.subtitle: Harmon Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Visit this non-profit gallery to see rotating exhibitions of contemporary art and student work. It is located on the first floor of the Harmon Fine Arts Center.
cards.short_summary: A free contemporary art gallery hosting curated exhibitions and student showcases.
cards.evidence_claim: All exhibitions and related events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Sunday, 12:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m. during the academic year.

cards.title: Join a Group Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Drake Recreational Services
cards.notes: Attend free Group X classes ranging from Yoga and Pilates to HIIT and Zumba. All equipment is provided for students at the Bell Center studios.
cards.short_summary: Free group exercise classes for students held at the campus recreation center.
cards.evidence_claim: All programs are free for all Drake students, faculty and staff unless otherwise noted.
cards.access_notes: Check the current semester schedule for class times; valid Drake ID required for entry.

cards.title: Study in the Reading Rooms
cards.subtitle: Main Campus Library
cards.notes: Find a quiet spot in the largest private academic library in Iowa. Use the open study tables or browse the extensive print and digital collections.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus library offering free study spaces and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library houses the University's general print and digital collections, all searchable online.
cards.access_notes: Public access is available during daytime hours; student ID required for late-night entry.

cards.title: Workout at the Student Gym
cards.subtitle: Olmsted Center Lower Level
cards.notes: Access cardio machines, free weights, and circuit training at this student-only facility located conveniently in the basement of the Olmsted Center.
cards.short_summary: A student-exclusive fitness center located in the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Underground Fitness is located in Olmsted and is a student-only fitness facility.
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the semester; restricted to current Drake students with ID.

cards.title: Attend a Free Recital
cards.subtitle: Old Main
cards.notes: Experience live music performances, including the 'Keys to Excellence' piano series and student recitals, in this historic 773-seat venue.
cards.short_summary: A historic auditorium hosting free musical performances and guest lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to both events is free. PRESENTATION: Sunday, Feb. 9 and 10 in Sheslow Auditorium.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts at Drake Archives | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Check the Fine Arts calendar for specific free event dates and times.

cards.title: Hang Out in the Student Hub
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Relax in the various lounge areas, use the open meeting rooms for group projects, or visit the breezeway for student organization displays.
cards.short_summary: The central student union featuring lounges, meeting spaces, and event hubs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Olmsted Center offers recreational facilities, a coffee-shop, event spaces, and study areas.
cards.access_notes: Open late during the academic semester for student use.

cards.title: Walk the Indoor Track
cards.subtitle: Athletics & Recreation Center
cards.notes: Use the 200-meter indoor track for walking or jogging. It is available for student recreation when not in use for intercollegiate athletic events.
cards.short_summary: An indoor athletic facility with a track available for student recreational use.
cards.evidence_claim: Recreation utilizes the building's track, four racquetball courts, walleyball court and gym space.
cards.source_title: Drake University Recreational Services | Campus Rec Magazine
cards.access_notes: Access is free for students with a valid Drake ID; check for event blackouts.

cards.title: Connect in the Renovated Center
cards.subtitle: Former Morehouse Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this modern, inclusive space designed for student engagement, leadership, and connection outside of the traditional classroom setting.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated student center focused on community and engagement.
cards.evidence_claim: The center serves as a venue for students to learn, lead, and connect.
cards.access_notes: Open to all Drake students during standard building hours.

cards.title: Watch a Free Movie
cards.subtitle: Student Activities Board Events
cards.notes: Join the Student Activities Board for 'Free Movie Friday' screenings of popular films and documentaries in the Sussman Theater.
cards.short_summary: Regular free movie screenings for students hosted by the Student Activities Board.
cards.evidence_claim: In collaboration with Student Activities Board (SAB), we'll be hosting the film... The event is free.
cards.source_title: Free Movie Friday | Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Events typically occur on Friday evenings; check the SAB calendar for titles.

cards.title: Tour Campus Public Art
cards.subtitle: Drake Neighborhood
cards.notes: Walk through the 'Dogtown' district adjacent to campus to view vibrant murals, including the iconic Dogtown mural near 25th Street.
cards.short_summary: Public murals and street art located in the neighborhood surrounding the university.
cards.evidence_claim: Don't forget to snap a picture with the Dogtown mural on their patio to commemorate the day!
cards.source_title: Sit, Stay, and Play in the Drake Neighborhood | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public art accessible 24/7 in the business district south of campus.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Choose ten distinct study environments. Verify access rules, room or reservation constraints, and the physical affordance that makes each useful. Treat “Claimed by 9am” as editorial framing; never assert crowding or student behavior without evidence.

cards.title: Cowles Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Access the largest private academic library in Iowa for quiet individual study. Use the online SuperSearch tool to locate physical and digital resources while you work.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library at Drake offering traditional quiet study environments and extensive digital archives.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library is the largest private academic library in Iowa and houses the University's general print and digital collections.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with Drake ID; check library website for seasonal hours.

cards.title: Collier-Scripps Collaboration Spaces
cards.subtitle: STEM and Education building
cards.notes: Utilize flexible collaboration spaces equipped with adjustable seating and large whiteboards. The glass-fronted design provides natural light for group study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A modern academic building featuring tech-enabled collaboration spaces and light-filled halls for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Collier-Scripps Hall offers collaboration spaces with adjustable seating, large whiteboards, and technology for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Academic building access typically follows class schedules; open to students.

cards.title: Olmsted Underground Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Student union lower level
cards.notes: Find these rooms adjacent to Underground Fitness. They remain unlocked during building hours and feature whiteboards for active brainstorming and writing.
cards.short_summary: Quiet meeting rooms located in the lower level of the student union, available for student use when not reserved.
cards.evidence_claim: Underneath the Olmsted Center are two meeting rooms adjacent to Underground Fitness that are unlocked for student use as long as Olmsted is open.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Available during Olmsted Center operating hours; check for posted reservations.

cards.title: Meredith Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Journalism school building
cards.notes: Study in a building designed by modernist architect Mies van der Rohe. The second-floor lounge provides a central spot between journalism and mass communication labs.
cards.short_summary: A historic modernist building featuring a dedicated student lounge and updated classroom technology.
cards.evidence_claim: Meredith Hall, designed by Mies van der Rohe, includes a student lounge on the second floor (Room 204) and media lab spaces.
cards.access_notes: General academic building hours; typically 7am-10pm on weekdays.

cards.title: Aliber Hall Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Zimpleman College of Business
cards.notes: Located on the lower level, this reading room serves business students. The building also houses computer labs and conference rooms for professional group work.
cards.short_summary: The primary hub for business students, offering a dedicated reading room and specialized labs.
cards.evidence_claim: Aliber Hall's lower level contains a computer classroom, an accounting laboratory, and a student reading room.
cards.access_notes: Open during business school hours; lower level access may require Drake ID.

cards.title: Cline Atrium for Pharmacy and Science
cards.subtitle: Pharmacy and Science complex
cards.notes: Study in the glass-enclosed atrium connecting Harvey Ingham and Cline Hall. This space was specifically designed to facilitate peer collaboration and science study.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass atrium providing a collaborative environment for pharmacy and science students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morgan E. Cline Atrium for Pharmacy and Science provides students a space to study and work with peers between Harvey Ingham and Cline Hall.
cards.source_title: distinctlyDrake brings visible changes to campus - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours; connects multiple science facilities.

cards.title: Carnegie Hall Graphics Labs
cards.subtitle: Historic graphic design hub
cards.notes: Graphic design students have 24-hour access to advanced computer labs on the top floor. The building also features a large gathering space for critiques and discussion.
cards.short_summary: A historic Carnegie library repurposed into a 24-hour design studio and lab space for art students.
cards.evidence_claim: Carnegie Hall houses Drake's Graphic Design program with 24-hour access to two large advanced computer graphics labs for students.
cards.source_title: College of Arts & Sciences Facilities | Drake University
cards.access_notes: 24-hour access for authorized Graphic Design students; public access during day hours.

cards.title: Opperman Law Library Carrels
cards.subtitle: Law School library
cards.notes: Reserve a study carrel or use the group study rooms designed for focused legal research. The library supports various learning styles with quiet and collaborative zones.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for law students featuring reservable carrels and quiet study resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Law Library offers study rooms, reservable carrels, and study aids to support different learning styles.
cards.access_notes: Drake Law students have ID access 6 a.m. to 12 a.m. daily; visitor hours vary.

cards.title: Harvey Ingham Science Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Chemistry and Physics building
cards.notes: Utilize renovated study spaces within this historic science building. A glass skywalk connects you to Fitch Hall, allowing for easy movement between science labs.
cards.short_summary: Renovated science building offering modern study areas for chemistry and physics students.
cards.evidence_claim: Recent renovations have transformed Harvey-Ingham into a building containing state-of-the-art laboratories and study spaces for the sciences.
cards.source_title: Harvey Ingham Hall - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; connected to Fitch Hall via skywalk.

cards.title: Goodwin-Kirk Beach Room
cards.subtitle: Residence hall study room
cards.notes: Sign out the key from the front desk to use this private study room. It offers a quiet alternative to the building's common areas for focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated, reservable study room within a residence hall for student privacy.
cards.evidence_claim: Every dorm hall has an open study room for students, like the Beach Room in Goodwin-Kirk, where keys can be signed out at the front desk.
cards.source_title: Study spots that are underutilized and underappreciated - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Available to residents; key checkout required at the front desk.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the Dogtown district and surrounding corridors just steps from Drake University's campus.

cards.title: Mars Cafe
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this space-themed coffee shop for espresso and local art. It serves as a central hub for students and neighbors on the University Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A space-themed local coffee staple on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Mars Cafe is located at 2318 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is a known local staple for coffee and artsy vibes.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from early morning until 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Drake Diner
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Stop by this 1950s-style retro diner for all-day breakfast and classic comfort food. It is a landmark destination just south of the main campus.
cards.short_summary: An iconic 1950s-style retro diner on 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Diner is located at 1111 25th St, Des Moines, IA, and has been a landmark since 1987 serving all-day breakfast.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; hours vary with late closing on weekends.

cards.title: The Varsity Cinema
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Catch an indie film or a classic at this renovated historic art house theater. It serves as a cultural anchor for the Dogtown district.
cards.short_summary: A historic nonprofit art house cinema on 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Varsity Cinema is located at 1207 25th Street, Des Moines, IA 50311, and reopened in 2022 as a nonprofit community art house.
cards.access_notes: Box office opens 30 minutes before the first show of the day.

cards.title: Jethro's BBQ
cards.subtitle: Forest Avenue
cards.notes: Dine at the original location of this famous Iowa BBQ chain. It is known for large portions and being a popular spot for watching Bulldog sports.
cards.short_summary: The original location of a famous Iowa BBQ chain on Forest Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Jethro's BBQ Drake is located at 3100 Forest Ave, Des Moines, IA, and is the original location of the chain.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner.

cards.title: xBk Live
cards.subtitle: 24th Street
cards.notes: Experience live music at this intimate 250-capacity venue. It hosts a wide range of genres and is a key part of the local performing arts scene.
cards.short_summary: An intimate live music and performing arts venue on 24th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: xBk Live is located at 1159 24th St, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is a 250-capacity venue for live experiences.
cards.access_notes: Hours vary based on scheduled performances; check their calendar for showtimes.

cards.title: Lucky Horse
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a burger and view the large Dogtown mural on the patio. This spot occupies the former site of a historic guitar shop in the heart of the district.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood burger joint with a signature Dogtown mural.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Horse Beer & Burgers is located at 2331 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and features a large Dogtown mural on its patio.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 11:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Dough Co. Pizza
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy New York-style thin-crust pizza by the slice or pie. It is a popular casual dining option for students located right on the University Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A New York-style pizzeria on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Dough Co. Pizza is located at 2330 University Ave, Des Moines, IA, and serves New York-style thin crust pizza.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for lunch and dinner.

cards.title: University Library Cafe
cards.subtitle: University Avenue
cards.notes: Try the famous nachos at this cozy neighborhood spot. Despite the name, it is a local eatery known for comfort food and a relaxed atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A cozy neighborhood eatery known for its nachos on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: University Library Cafe is located at 3506 University Ave, Des Moines, IA 50311, and is famous for its nachos.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; serves breakfast on weekends. Closes at 11:00 PM or 12:00 AM.

cards.title: Farmers Market
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Shop for local produce and handmade goods at this seasonal market. It brings the community together every Wednesday afternoon during the summer months.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal community farmers market at 25th and University.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Neighborhood Farmers Market is held in the parking lot of First Christian Church at 25th and University on Wednesdays from June to September.
cards.access_notes: Open Wednesdays, June through September, from 4:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

cards.title: Anderson Gallery
cards.subtitle: 25th Street
cards.notes: Explore contemporary art exhibitions at this gallery located within the Harmon Fine Arts Center. It is free and open to the public during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A contemporary art gallery on the edge of campus at 25th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Anderson Gallery is located at 1310 25th St, at the corner of Carpenter and 25th, and offers free public admission.
cards.source_title: Drake University Anderson Gallery - Contact Us
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Sunday during exhibitions; closed Mondays and during university holidays.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing customs that define the Bulldog spirit at Drake University, from painted streets to pageant-winning pups.

cards.title: Painting the Pavement
cards.subtitle: A colorful kickoff to Relays week
cards.notes: Student groups raffle for squares on Carpenter Avenue to paint murals matching the annual Relays theme. The street remains a vibrant campus centerpiece throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: An annual tradition where student organizations paint murals on a designated campus street to celebrate the Drake Relays.
cards.evidence_claim: Student organizations enter a raffle to earn a spot on the street and paint designs correlating with the Relays theme.
cards.source_title: Student organizations celebrate beloved Drake Relays tradition: Painted Street
cards.access_notes: The street is a public campus walkway located on Carpenter Avenue between Cowles Library and Jewett Hall.

cards.title: The Most Beautiful Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A pageant for the wrinkliest contestants
cards.notes: Watch 24 English Bulldogs compete for the crown at the Knapp Center. The winner serves as the official mascot for the Drake Relays and receives a key to the city.
cards.short_summary: A nationally recognized pageant where English Bulldogs compete to be named the official mascot of the Drake Relays.
cards.evidence_claim: The 47th Annual Beautiful Bulldog Contest in 2026 crowned Flora as the champion to serve as the official Relays mascot.
cards.source_title: The Beautiful Bulldog Contest® | Drake University
cards.access_notes: Held annually at the Knapp Center; open to the public to attend and watch the pageant.

cards.title: Pucker Up at the Rock
cards.subtitle: A 40-ton boulder of romantic luck
cards.notes: Legend says couples who kiss on this rock at midnight will have a lifetime of happiness. It marks the spot where the university's founder first declared the campus site.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus boulder near Old Main associated with romantic legends and university founding history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kissing Rock has remained outside Old Main since 1898 as a mythic stone that gives luck to Drake couples who kiss there.
cards.source_title: SAA Kissing Rock - Drake University Calendar
cards.access_notes: Located on the southeast corner of Old Main; accessible 24/7 as a campus landmark.

cards.title: Hubbelling Down the Hill
cards.subtitle: Improvised winter sledding
cards.notes: When snow hits, students use trays (or modern alternatives) to sled down the hills of the Quads. The name comes from the Hubbell Dining Hall trays once used for the sport.
cards.short_summary: A winter tradition of sledding down campus hills, historically using trays from the dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hubbelling is a winter downhill sport named for the trays from Hubbell Dining Hall used as sleds.
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the hills near the Quad dormitory area during snowfall.

cards.title: The Return of Old Brassie
cards.subtitle: Ringing in the Relays
cards.notes: Revived in 2026 after 40 years, the ringing of the Old Main bell now signals the start of the annual Paint Fight and Relays week festivities.
cards.short_summary: The ceremonial ringing of the historic Old Main bell to mark the beginning of major campus celebrations.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake University revived its bell-ringing tradition after 40 years to signal the start of the Paint Fight and Relays week.
cards.source_title: Old Brassie is back - Drake University
cards.access_notes: The bell is located in the tower of Old Main; the ringing ceremony is held outdoors nearby.

cards.title: The Annual Paint Fight
cards.subtitle: A messy start to the week
cards.notes: Hundreds of students gather between Cowles Library and Painted Street for a massive, colorful paint fight. Participants must use latex-free and oil-free paint.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy event where students throw paint at each other to celebrate the start of Relays week.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake students are invited to Painted Street to join in the chaos of the annual Paint Fight.
cards.access_notes: Held in the open area between Cowles Library and Painted Street.

cards.title: Rubbing Griff for Luck
cards.subtitle: A bronze bulldog blessing
cards.notes: Located in Bulldog Plaza, this larger-than-life bronze sculpture of the live mascot Griff is a popular spot for students to rub for good luck before exams or games.
cards.short_summary: A bronze statue of the university's live mascot that serves as a focal point for campus luck and photos.
cards.evidence_claim: The larger-than-life Griff statue in Bulldog Plaza is a central campus attraction for students and alumni.
cards.source_title: Drake University Bulldog Plaza - Hansen Company
cards.access_notes: Located in Bulldog Plaza in front of Old Main; accessible to the public.

cards.title: Fridays with the Mascot
cards.subtitle: Weekly meet-and-greets
cards.notes: Every Friday, the live mascot Griff (currently Griff III) holds office hours in Cowles Hall to meet with prospective students and provide stress relief for current ones.
cards.short_summary: A weekly event where the live bulldog mascot interacts with the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: Griff can be spotted meeting with prospective students at 'Fridays with Griff' in Cowles Hall.
cards.source_title: The Evolution of the Bulldog - Drake University Newsroom
cards.access_notes: Held weekly in Cowles Hall; check the mascot's social media for specific times.

cards.title: The Cheeseburger Bulldog
cards.subtitle: A whimsical dining hall guardian
cards.notes: This unique painted statue outside Hubbell Dining Hall features a bulldog wearing a chef's hat. It was recently restored to honor a long-time university staff member's mother.
cards.short_summary: A beloved, whimsical bulldog statue located outside the main dining hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The cheeseburger bulldog statue outside of Hubbell Dining Hall was repainted and returned to campus with an added chef's hat.
cards.source_title: Cheeseburger Griff returns after one and a half years - The Times-Delphic
cards.access_notes: Located outside Hubbell Dining Hall; visible to all passersby.

cards.title: Running the Blue Oval
cards.subtitle: The heart of America's Athletic Classic
cards.notes: The iconic blue track at Drake Stadium is the site of the Drake Relays. Students and community members finish the Drake Road Races here to kick off the week.
cards.short_summary: The world-famous blue track at Drake Stadium, central to the university's athletic identity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Relays returns to Drake Stadium for its 116th edition, drawing fans to the iconic Blue Oval.
cards.source_title: The Blue Oval Awaits: Your Essential Guide to the 116th Drake Relays
cards.access_notes: Located inside Drake Stadium; access is typically restricted to events and scheduled races.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Drake University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A sequence of essential campus experiences and traditions for new Bulldogs during their first weekend in Des Moines.

cards.title: Unload at Your Residence Hall
cards.subtitle: The Official Start of Move-In
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned time slot to meet the 'Bulldog Crew' of student volunteers who help carry your gear to your new room.
cards.short_summary: The coordinated move-in process for new first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: New first-year students' Move-In Day is scheduled for Wednesday, August 19, with specific time slots selected via email.
cards.access_notes: Requires pre-selected time slot and government-issued ID for check-in.

cards.title: Grab Lunch with Your PMAC
cards.subtitle: First Meal at Hubbell
cards.notes: Meet your Peer Mentor Academic Consultant (PMAC) and First Year Seminar group for a community lunch at the main campus dining hall.
cards.short_summary: The primary dining facility for Drake students located near the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Welcome Weekend includes a scheduled lunch in Hubbell Dining Hall at 12:00 PM for new students and their PMAC groups.
cards.access_notes: Standard meal hours for lunch are typically 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM; requires meal plan or payment.

cards.title: Join the Traditions Carnival
cards.subtitle: Afternoon Campus Celebration
cards.notes: Head to the central campus green for games and activities designed to introduce you to Drake's unique history and school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A social event held during Welcome Weekend to introduce campus traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Drake Traditions Carnival is a featured event on the Welcome Weekend schedule, typically held at 1:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open to all new students during Welcome Weekend.

cards.title: Cheer at a Soccer Match
cards.subtitle: First Home Game Experience
cards.notes: Walk over to the stadium to support the Bulldogs in a Welcome Weekend match, a common first-weekend athletic tradition.
cards.short_summary: A home athletic event often integrated into the orientation schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: The Welcome Weekend schedule includes a 'Welcome Weekend at Drake Soccer' event at 4:30 PM.
cards.access_notes: Students typically receive free admission with their Drake ID.

cards.title: Catch an SAB Performance
cards.subtitle: Late Night Entertainment
cards.notes: Visit the student union for evening entertainment hosted by the Student Activities Board, ranging from comedians to musicians.
cards.short_summary: The hub for student programming and evening activities on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Student Activities Board (SAB) Entertainment is scheduled for 8:00 PM during Welcome Weekend at the Olmsted Center.
cards.access_notes: Late-night programming is a staple of the Olmsted Center during the semester.

cards.title: Walk the Painted Street
cards.subtitle: A Colorful Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Stroll down Carpenter Avenue to see the colorful squares painted by student organizations, a tradition dating back decades.
cards.short_summary: A section of Carpenter Avenue decorated with murals by student groups.
cards.evidence_claim: Street Painting is a major Drake tradition where organizations decorate squares on the street along Carpenter Avenue.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible sidewalk; best viewed during daylight hours.

cards.title: Find the Kissing Rock
cards.subtitle: Historic Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Locate this 40-ton boulder near Old Main, which serves as a landmark for university history and various student legends.
cards.short_summary: A historic rock located east of Old Main with long-standing campus legends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Kissing Rock is located on the southeast corner of Old Main and is a stop on Welcome Weekend scavenger hunts.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Explore Cowles Library
cards.subtitle: Academic Hub and Study Space
cards.notes: Take a self-guided tour of the library to find your favorite study nook and check out the 'Midnight Hall' for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: The main academic library providing research support and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Cowles Library hosts info sessions and is a key resource introduced during orientation programs.
cards.access_notes: Standard semester hours often extend late; check current schedule for weekend access.

cards.title: Browse the Activity Fair
cards.subtitle: Find Your Student Org
cards.notes: Meet representatives from over 150 student clubs and organizations to find ways to get involved beyond the classroom.
cards.short_summary: An annual fair showcasing student organizations and involvement opportunities.
cards.evidence_claim: Drake University hosts a Student Activity Fair each year where students can learn about different clubs and organizations.
cards.access_notes: Typically held outdoors or in the Olmsted Center during the first week of classes.

cards.title: Get Your Bulldog Gear
cards.subtitle: Official Campus Shop
cards.notes: Visit the bookstore to pick up your textbooks and stock up on Drake apparel before the first day of classes.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for textbooks, supplies, and university merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Book Store is a key campus destination located near the Olmsted Center.
cards.access_notes: Check for special extended hours during move-in weekend.
